note: Nominotypical subspecies; the morphological description follows G. globosus (redescription by Holmgren 1913, in German). The original is in German and was extracted by OCR from the Internet Archive scan; a few word forms and figures are misrecognized (e.g. l,i for 1,1) and have been checked against the context; measurements are in mm as in the original.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Nominotypical subspecies (the type form of Hamitermes (Globitermes) globosus in the original). Soldier with the head wider than long and almost perfectly circular, the mandibles strongly curved and with a long posteriorly directed tooth beyond the middle, antennae 15-segmented; the alate has no vein between the radius sector and the mediana.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Body length 3.5 mm (large form)/3.2 mm (small form); head with mandibles 1.52/1.41 mm; head length without mandibles 0.8/0.66 mm; head width 0.95/0.76 mm; pronotum width 0.61/0.49 mm. Head brownish yellow, mandibles brown, body white; antennae 15-segmented; anterior part of the postmentum strongly inflated as a projection.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Length with wings 9 mm, body length without wings 5.6 mm, forewing length 7—7.6 mm; head length 1.4 mm, width 0.99 mm; pronotum width 0.8 mm, length 0.46 mm. The wing has no vein between the radius sector and the mediana.
